asr.full_text: Grow your bitcoin with Mirror trading International Introducing the Mirror trading International Company Mirror trading International is a registered company in the Republic of South Africa. The registered office is situated at 341 Bears Nordea Drive in Northcliffe, South Africa. Johann Steinbach is the CEO and founder from Polakwani in South Africa. The attorneys and legal advisors of Mirror Trading International are Hisland Koenig, who have their offices in Randburg, Johannesburg. The objective of Mirror Trading International is to grow your Bitcoin. Your balance in trade is always in Bitcoin, and you earn Bitcoin daily. When the price of Bitcoin rises, the value of your trading account will go up. Meritrading International has a sustainable business model trading forex using advanced intelligence software with bitcoin as the base currency. The profitability of Meritrading International comes solely from the trading activities. Your full investment goes into your trading accounts Miro Trading International provides you with a passive income opportunity earn passively from daily trading which takes place from Monday to Friday the trade results are not guaranteed no trading knowledge is required To get started you will need a Bitcoin wallet to register with Miro Trading International and a hundred dollars in bitcoin which is the suggested minimum To be started, you will need a Bitcoin wallet, to register with Mirror Trading International, and one hundred dollars in bitcoin, which is the suggested minimum. You will need to fund your account within seven days. Accounts not funded will be deleted from the system after seven days. In Mirror Trading International, there are no membership fees, no subscriptions, no packages, no costs, and no deductions. Your full Bitcoin payment goes to your trading account. There are no contracts or lockdowns. You can withdraw in full or partial amounts and you can withdraw whenever you like. There are no withdrawal fees or penalties. Withdrawal requests will be sent to your Bitcoin wallet within 48 hours, as long as it's not over a weekend, because then it might take a bit longer. Profits from successful daily trades are divided and allocated as follows. 40% to you the member, 30% to the trading system, 10% to Mirra Trading International for administration and to pay the referral bonuses, and 20% to the binary profit sharing bonuses. All income is subject to positive daily trading results. The system is fully automated and you can sit back and relax and receive your daily statements, detailing the income from the trades for the day. Your daily trade income is automatically compounded. Members are not permitted their own broker accounts as per the terms of the Software license Agreement. Your account remains active provided you maintain a minimum balance in trade. The suggested amount is 100 dollars in bitcoin providing you with a passive sustainable income from your bitcoin in trade is at the very heart of mirror trading international. That summarises the passive part of the opportunity to grow your bitcoin in the name of MIRROR TRADING INTERNATIONAL. Mirror Trading international has an optional affiliate program should you wish to refer your friends or new members if you have questions or for more information please contact CLINT

textual.observation: The service promotes earning Bitcoin daily and passive income through trading, while asking viewers to register with a Bitcoin wallet, provide a suggested minimum of one hundred dollars in Bitcoin, and fund the account within seven days.

evidence.quote: Your balance in trade is always in Bitcoin, and you earn Bitcoin daily.
To get started you will need a Bitcoin wallet to register with Miro Trading International and a hundred dollars in bitcoin which is the suggested minimum
You will need to fund your account within seven days.

textual.context: Promotional investment opportunity; the source presents the claims as features of the service.
textual.potential_relevance: The promised daily/passive Bitcoin return is directly linked to registering with a Bitcoin wallet, transferring a suggested minimum amount, and meeting a seven-day funding condition.
textual.limitations: These records do not establish whether the service, company, trading activity, investment, or stated returns are genuine, guaranteed, or completed.

textual.observation: The service describes profit-sharing and an optional affiliate program that can provide referral bonuses for referring friends or new members.

evidence.quote: 10% to Mirra Trading International for administration and to pay the referral bonuses, and 20% to the binary profit sharing bonuses.
Mirror Trading international has an optional affiliate
program should you wish to refer your friends or new members

textual.context: The affiliate and referral arrangement is presented as optional and as part of the service's promotional description.
textual.potential_relevance: A potential referral benefit is linked to recruiting friends or new members, while the source also describes portions of trading profits being allocated to referral and binary profit-sharing bonuses.
textual.limitations: The records do not specify the amount, eligibility rules, payment history, or whether recruitment is required for participation or returns.

visual.observation: Slides state an objective to "GROW YOUR BITCOIN" and later "Earn Passively from the daily trading activities and GROW YOUR BITCOIN."
visual.context: Branded presentation for Mirror Trading International with Bitcoin-themed graphics; promotion versus informational discussion is unclear from sampled frames alone.
visual.potential_relevance: A promised Bitcoin growth/passive earning outcome is visibly tied to a trading opportunity described elsewhere in the sampled presentation.
visual.limitations: The frames do not show actual deposits, trades, returns, user accounts, or whether any promised outcome occurred.

visual.observation: Slides describe trading Forex using "Advanced Intelligence Software" with Bitcoin as the base currency and say viewers can "Earn passively from Daily Trading" with no trading experience required.
visual.context: The same slide also says trading occurs Monday-Friday and includes the qualification "Trade results not guaranteed."
visual.potential_relevance: A passive income claim is linked to participation in a Bitcoin-based Forex trading model where the viewer is told no trading experience is required.
visual.limitations: Sparse frames cannot establish how participation begins, what software is used, whether the software exists, or whether the activity is promotional rather than descriptive.

visual.observation: One slide states "Your Full Bitcoin Payment goes to trade" after listing no membership fees, subscriptions, packages, costs, or deductions.
visual.context: The statement appears in a branded trading presentation and refers specifically to a Bitcoin payment.
visual.potential_relevance: A money-flow claim is tied to a requested Bitcoin payment and asserts the full amount is applied to trading rather than fees or deductions.
visual.limitations: The frame does not show a wallet address, payment screen, recipient, transaction, contract terms, or proof of how any payment is handled.

visual.observation: A slide says the account remains active if a minimum balance is maintained in trade, with a suggested amount of "$100 in Bitcoin."
visual.context: This appears after slides describing passive daily trading and Bitcoin growth.
visual.potential_relevance: A condition for account activity is linked to maintaining a Bitcoin-denominated trading balance.
visual.limitations: The sampled frames do not show whether the amount is mandatory, where funds are sent, how balances are verified, or what happens if the balance is not maintained.

visual.observation: A slide says there is "NO Contract/Lock down" and that users can withdraw in full or partial whenever they want with no withdrawal fees or penalties.
visual.context: The liquidity claim appears within the same Bitcoin trading presentation.
visual.potential_relevance: A withdrawal-condition claim is tied to funds placed in the trading account and describes unrestricted access to those funds.
visual.limitations: The frames do not show an actual withdrawal interface, withdrawal history, terms and conditions, or whether withdrawals are completed.

visual.observation: The final frame provides a named contact for questions with a WhatsApp number and email address under Mirror Trading International branding.
visual.context: The contact details appear after slides about Bitcoin trading, passive earning, account balance, and withdrawal terms.
visual.potential_relevance: A direct contact method is presented in connection with the described Bitcoin trading opportunity and related account/payment conditions.
visual.limitations: The sampled frames do not show any conversation, sign-up instruction, identity verification, payment request through the contact, or outcome after contacting.

textual_context_notes.observation: The source expressly states that trading results are not guaranteed and that income depends on positive daily trading results.

evidence.quote: the trade results are not guaranteed
All income is subject to positive daily trading results.

textual_context_notes.observation: The source states that members are not permitted to have their own broker accounts under the software license agreement.

evidence.quote: Members are not permitted their own broker accounts as per the terms of the Software license Agreement.

visual_context_notes.observation: The presentation includes the qualification "Trade results not guaranteed."
A slide showing daily trading income allocation includes the note "Historical results are no guarantee of future results."
A branded slide displays a registered office address in South Africa and the website "www.mirrortradinginternational.com."
A daily statement slide says income statements are sent by email and can also be found in the back office.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it presents Mirror Trading International as an investor opportunity promising growth and daily Bitcoin earnings through passive trading, while directing viewers to register a Bitcoin wallet, provide suggested Bitcoin funding, maintain a trading balance, and fund the account within seven days. It also describes referral and binary profit-sharing allocations as part of the promoted arrangement. The presentation includes non-guarantee and historical-results limitations, and does not establish whether deposits, trading, withdrawals, or returns were completed.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The video promotes an automated trading system, requires Bitcoin funding to activate the account, and links that funding to daily trading income. This directly supports a trading-bot or funded-contract returns mechanism.
